sections.content: *Eszik* (eats) and *iszik* (drinks) are -ik verbs, like *dolgozik*: the ending is *-ik* only for *ő*. Their stems are *esz-* and *isz-*. With *én* the ending is *-em* and *-om*: *eszem* and *iszom*. Learn the whole rows as they are.

sections.title: The object
sections.content: What you eat or drink takes *-t*, as in the last lesson: *teát iszom*, *húst eszem*. Hungarians eat soup, so you say *levest eszem*. New words: *bor* (wine, *bort* with *-t*), *tojás* (egg, *tojást*), *hús* (meat, *húst*).

items.english: In the morning I drink coffee.
In the evening we eat cheese.

sections.content: Do not say *iszok* or *eszek* for “I”. The *én* forms of these two verbs are *iszom* and *eszem*, like *dolgozom*.
